metadata.question: Was the aerosol optical depth higher over Chiang Mai, Thailand during March 2024 than Bangkok, Thailand?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Use NASA’s MCD19A2 (MODIS/Terra+Aqua Land Aerosol Optical Depth) or “MODIS/006/MCD19A2”. It has an ‘Optical_Depth_047’ band and daily data. - Dates: March 2024 == 2024-03-01 to 2024-03-31. - Locations: – Chiang Mai ≈ Point(98.97, 18.82) – Bangkok ≈ Point(100.50, 13.75) 2. Masking strategy: - Quality-flag mask inside MCD19A2 (‘QA’ band); keep only best-quality retrievals (QA=0 or QA=1). 3. Logic to distinguish valid zero from null/error: - After masking: run ee.Reducer.mean() for each city. If result is None/NaN, output C3. Else compare means. - Also run ee.Reducer.count() to confirm we have at least one valid pixel for each city (if count==0 → C2). - If the whole collection is empty for either city → C1. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') chiangmai = ee.Geometry.Point(98.97, 18.82) bangkok = ee.Geometry.Point(100.50, 13.75) start, end = '2024-03-01', '2024-03-31' def get_aoa_mean(loc, name): col = (ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD19A2') .filterDate(start, end) .select(['Optical_Depth_047'], ['aod']) .map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('QA').eq(0).Or(img.select('QA').eq(1))))) if col.size().getInfo() == 0: print(f"{name}: No images") return None, 0 img = col.mean() stats = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True), geometry=loc, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9) mean = stats.get('aod_mean').getInfo() count = stats.get('aod_count').getInfo() return mean, count cm_mean, cm_cnt = get_aoa_mean(chiangmai, "CM") bk_mean, bk_cnt = get_aoa_mean(bangkok, "BK") if cm_mean is None or bk_mean is None: print("C1") elif cm_cnt == 0 or bk_cnt == 0: print("Valid pixels: CM=%d BK=%d" % (cm_cnt, bk_cnt)) print("C2") elif cm_mean != cm_mean or bk_mean != bk_mean: # NaN check print("C3") else: print("AOD 047 Mar2024 — CM: %.3f (pixels %d) BK: %.3f (pixels %d)" % (cm_mean, cm_cnt, bk_mean, bk_cnt)) print("A" if cm_mean > bk_mean else "B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

chiangmai = ee.Geometry.Point(98.97, 18.82)
bangkok = ee.Geometry.Point(100.50, 13.75)

start, end = '2024-03-01', '2024-03-31'

def get_aoa_mean(loc, name):
    col = (ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD19A2')
             .filterDate(start, end)
             .select(['Optical_Depth_047'], ['aod'])
             .map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('QA').eq(0).Or(img.select('QA').eq(1)))))
    if col.size().getInfo() == 0:
        print(f"{name}: No images")
        return None, 0
    img = col.mean()
    stats = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True),
                             geometry=loc, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9)
    mean = stats.get('aod_mean').getInfo()
    count = stats.get('aod_count').getInfo()
    return mean, count

cm_mean, cm_cnt = get_aoa_mean(chiangmai, "CM")
bk_mean, bk_cnt = get_aoa_mean(bangkok, "BK")

if cm_mean is None or bk_mean is None:
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
elif cm_cnt == 0 or bk_cnt == 0:
    print("Valid pixels: CM=%d  BK=%d" % (cm_cnt, bk_cnt))
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
elif cm_mean != cm_mean or bk_mean != bk_mean:  # NaN check
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
else:
    print("AOD 047 Mar2024 — CM: %.3f (pixels %d)  BK: %.3f (pixels %d)" % (cm_mean, cm_cnt, bk_mean, bk_cnt))
    print("<answer>A</answer>" if cm_mean > bk_mean else "<answer>B</answer>")
